prompt.text: You set the bag down for a minute. When you turn around it is gone. The laptop was asleep, not shut down.

choices.label: Wait and see if it turns up
choices.debrief: Asleep is not locked down. The drive is still the company's.
choices.report: A missing laptop was not reported.
choices.voice_line: You waited on a missing laptop instead of calling it in.

fallout.text: The drive is copied before anyone asks for a wipe.

choices.label: Call the help desk now and say it is missing
choices.debrief: They can kill the session and start the wipe while you are still on the street.
choices.report: The missing laptop was reported the same hour.
choices.voice_line: You called the help desk and told them the laptop was gone.

choices.label: Try to lock it from your phone, and tell no one
choices.debrief: A remote lock you hope went through is not a report.
choices.bark: You tried to lock it yourself.
choices.report: You tried a remote lock and did not report the loss.
choices.voice_line: You tried to lock it from your phone and did not call.

fallout.text: The lock never reached it. No one else knows it is gone.

draft_note: Report is the right outcome even if a remote lock is also started.
